title: Continuous glucose monitor (CGM)
disclaimer: Illustrative criteria written for this demo project. Not an actual Medicare, Medicaid, or commercial payer policy.

criteria.text: Diagnosis of diabetes mellitus (type 1 or type 2).
Treated with insulin, OR documented history of problematic hypoglycemia (level 2 or level 3 events).
In-person or telehealth visit with the treating practitioner within 6 months before the request.
